WP_STEPS|/prepB/points/0: suitable substrates: concrete, masonry work, plasters P II and P III, cement-based screed, old firmly adhering bituminous substrates
WP_STEPS|/prepB/points/1: depressions > 5 mm and uneven substrates are levelled with {M30}; on uneven substrates pre-sealing can also take place with {M30}
WP_STEPS|/prepB/points/2: in the case of substrates damaged by de-icing salt, remove down to the neutral area (milling)
WP_STEPS|/prepB/points/3: moisture penetration from the rear and intermittent moisture loading from the negative side must be avoided
WP_STEPS|/tape/title: Insert the joint sealing tapes and sleeves
WP_STEPS|/tape/short: ASO-Dichtband-2000 system in the wall–floor joint, corners and sleeves, bonded in AQUAFIN-2K/M-PLUS.
WP_STEPS|/tape/overview: Use the ASO-Dichtband-2000 system along with the required pre-formed pieces to form movement and connecting joints as well as to integrate intersections and assembly parts. Bond joint sealing tapes, joint-tape edges or connections with the waterproofing material and fill in the overlap area and the edge zone with filler.
WP_STEPS|/tape/points/0: in the area of structural movement joints the waterproofing is reinforced with ADF-Dehnfugenband or ASO-Dichtband-2000-S
WP_STEPS|/tape/points/1: floor drains and intersections must be provided with suitable flange elements; check linear drainage systems for suitability in advance
WP_STEPS|/tape/points/2: on PVC, gunmetal and stainless steel flanges, ASO-Dichtmanschetten or ADF-Pipe-Gasket are installed without voids or wrinkles
WP_STEPS|/mix2K/short: 50–60 % of the liquid first, powder in, the rest of the liquid; 3 minutes; mature; homogenise.
WP_STEPS|/mix2K/overview: Fill approx. 50–60 % of the liquid component into a clean mixing bucket and mix with the powder component to produce a homogeneous, lump-free mass. Finally add the rest of the liquid component and mix sufficiently. Mix ratio A : B = 2.5 : 1 by weight. The mixing time is approx. 3 minutes; after a settling period of approx. 5 minutes, thoroughly homogenise the compound again.
WP_STEPS|/mix2K/points/0: depending on the application technique (slurry and spray technique) add max. 0.5 l water per 35 kg, after mixing
WP_STEPS|/mix2K/points/1: pot life approx. 60 minutes at approx. 5–30 °C
WP_STEPS|/mix2K/points/2: wet film thickness approx. 1.1 mm yields 1 mm dry film thickness
WP_STEPS|/coatB1/title: Apply the first coat of AQUAFIN-2K/M-PLUS
WP_STEPS|/coatB1/short: Trowel, brush or spray; up to 1 mm per step, free of pores; even thickness with the notched trowel, then smoothing.
WP_STEPS|/coatB1/overview: Apply {AQ2K} in a minimum of two application steps ensuring it is free of pores. Max. layer thickness per application step: up to 1 mm. An even layer thickness is achieved using a coating thickness trowel or notched trowel and then smoothing.
WP_STEPS|/coatB1/points/0: consumption bonded with tiles/boards: > 2.0 mm dry film, approx. 2.2 mm wet, 3.5 kg/m²
WP_STEPS|/coatB1/points/1: can be trowelled off; machine application after Technical Information No. 43
WP_STEPS|/coatB1/points/2: in case of strong sunlight work against the movement of the sun in shaded areas
WP_STEPS|/coatB2/title: Apply the second coat after approx. 3–6 hours
WP_STEPS|/coatB2/short: To > 2.0 mm total dry film thickness; never more than 2 kg/m² in one step.
WP_STEPS|/coatB2/overview: The second application step (and subsequent ones) can be carried out after approx. 3–6 hours. An application thickness of more than 2 kg/m² in one application step can lead to cracking.
WP_STEPS|/coatB2/points/1: the waterproofing layer must be completely hardened at the time of the laying work
WP_STEPS|/tiles/short: With one of the tile adhesives of the system list, after the waterproofing has completely hardened.
WP_STEPS|/tiles/overview: Tiles or boards are laid with one of the tile adhesives listed in the system components section (e.g. MONOFLEX, SOLOFLEX, UNIFIX-S3, CRISTALLIT-FLEX, LIGHTFLEX). The waterproofing layer must be completely hardened at the time of the laying work.
WP_STEPS|/tiles/points/0: apply the sealing sleeves in accordance with their technical data sheet; floor drains and intersections with suitable flange elements
WP_STEPS|/tiles/points/1: the waterproofing as a surface coating must not be exposed to point or linear loads
WP_STEPS|/tiles/points/2: frost, de-icing salt, UV and age resistant
WP_STEPS|/joints/short: Movement and connecting joints with the ASO-Dichtband system and an elastic sealant; the coating may be plastered or painted.
WP_STEPS|/joints/overview: Movement and connecting joints are formed with the ASO-Dichtband-2000 system. Where it stays exposed, {AQ2K} may be plastered and coated with vapour permeable, solvent-free dispersion facade paints or dispersion silicate paints (not pure silicate paints); silicon resin and acrylate-based paints may also be used.
WP_STEPS|/joints/points/0: tile grouts and joint sealants of the SCHOMBURG tile system — see the product group “Tile / Natural Stone / Screed Installation”
WP_STEPS|/planP/short: Underground garages and car parks: chloride and carbonation barrier, crack bridging at −20 °C, approx. 5.5 kg/m².
WP_STEPS|/planP/overview: {OS} is the approved surface protection system according to OS 5b and EN 1504-2 for underground garages and multi-storey car parks: a protective coating against chloride attack and carbonation, for the renovation and protection of concrete surfaces prone to cracking. Consumption after OS 5b and EN 1504-2: approx. 5.5 kg/m².
WP_STEPS|/planP/points/0: crack bridging DIN EN 1062-7: static class A4 (2.0 mm) at +20 °C; dynamic class B2 at −20 °C and after 2000 h of UV weathering
WP_STEPS|/planP/points/1: water vapour permeability class I (Sd > 50 m); CO₂ permeability Sd > 200 m
WP_STEPS|/planP/points/2: suitable substrate: concrete with a tensile adhesion strength of 1.5 N/mm²
WP_STEPS|/prepP/short: Salt-damaged concrete milled off to the neutral zone, blasted or jetted, matt damp; primed where very absorbent.
WP_STEPS|/prepP/overview: Requirement for the substrate: even, free of adhesion inhibiting substances, sealed in the surface, pore open, load-bearing, extensively fully grouted. In the case of substrates damaged by de-icing salt, the substrate must be removed down to the neutral area, e.g. by milling. Pre-moisten the dry substrate so that it is matt damp at the time of application.
WP_STEPS|/prepP/points/0: extremely absorbent and slightly sandy substrates must be primed with {PRIM}
WP_STEPS|/prepP/points/1: moisture penetration from the rear and intermittent moisture loading from the negative side must be avoided
WP_STEPS|/prepP/points/2: the concrete restoration of the deck (breakouts, reinforcement) follows the guide “Concrete restoration”
WP_STEPS|/mixOS/short: Liquid component into the bucket, powder in, 3 minutes; mature 2 minutes; homogenise again.
WP_STEPS|/mixOS/overview: Put the liquid component into a clean mixing bucket and mix with the powder component to produce a homogeneous, lump-free mass (mix ratio A : B = 2 : 1 by weight). The mixing time is approx. 3 minutes. After a settling period of approx. 2 minutes, thoroughly homogenise the compound again.
WP_STEPS|/mixOS/points/0: stirrer approx. 500–700 rpm with a suitable mixing paddle
WP_STEPS|/mixOS/points/1: pot life approx. 30 minutes at approx. 5–30 °C
WP_STEPS|/scratch/short: AQUAFIN-OS pressed into the substrate with the trowel before the first layer.
WP_STEPS|/scratch/overview: Apply {OS} as a scratch coat and contact layer before the first application. Immediately afterwards, the first layer of sealant is applied wet on wet.
WP_STEPS|/scratch/points/0: the scratch coat closes pores and blowholes and gives the contact to the concrete
WP_STEPS|/scratch/points/1: tools: trowel, serrated or layer-thickness trowel, flat trowel, brush, spray equipment
WP_STEPS|/coatP1/short: Immediately after the scratch coat; up to 3 mm per application step, approx. 1.8 kg/m² per mm.
WP_STEPS|/coatP1/overview: Immediately after the scratch coat, the first layer of {OS} is applied wet on wet. Max. layer thickness per application step: up to 3 mm; consumption approx. 1.8 kg/m² per mm.
WP_STEPS|/coatP1/points/0: can be trowelled off and applied with a brush; machine application after Technical Information No. 43
WP_STEPS|/coatP1/points/1: protect surfaces that are not to be treated; in strong sunlight work in shaded areas
WP_STEPS|/coatP2/short: When the first layer can no longer be damaged; total approx. 5.5 kg/m² for OS 5b.
WP_STEPS|/coatP2/overview: The second application step (and following) can take place when the first application step can no longer be damaged by reworking — overcoat after approx. 3 hours. The waiting time between layers depends on temperature, humidity and other ambient conditions. Total consumption after OS 5b and EN 1504-2: approx. 5.5 kg/m².
WP_STEPS|/coatP2/points/1: the waterproofing must not be affected by water during binding
WP_STEPS|/cureP/short: Rainproof after 4 hours; no point or linear loads on the coating; may be painted with vapour permeable paints.
WP_STEPS|/cureP/overview: {OS} as a surface coating must not be exposed to point or linear loads. It may be coated with vapour permeable, solvent-free dispersion facade paints or dispersion silicate paints; silicon resin and acrylate-based paints may also be used.
WP_STEPS|/cureP/points/0: direct contact with metals such as copper, zinc and aluminium is avoided by a pore-sealed primer of ASODUR-GBM in two steps
WP_STEPS|/cureP/points/1: the completed OS 5b system protects against chloride ingress and carbonation and bridges cracks at −20 °C
WPS_T|/ext/name: Basement wall in ground contact, from the outside
WPS_T|/ext/problem: Ground moisture, seepage water and — with poorly permeable subsoil or backwater — pressing water act on the outside of the basement wall and on the wall–slab joint (DIN 18533: W1.1-E, W1.2-E, W2.1-E; W4-E at the wall base).
WPS_T|/ext/solution: The system “External waterproofing to basements — mineral-based”: substrate levelled with {M30}, sealing cove of {M30} on a bonding slurry of {AQ1K}, pipe penetrations with the sleeve, two coats of {RB400} to the dry film thickness of the class (2.0–4.0 mm), protection and drainage boards bonded with {RB400} and quartz sand, backfilled.
WPS_T|/inner/name: Retroactive waterproofing from the inside, WTA 4-6
WPS_T|/inner/problem: An existing basement wall takes up water from the soil behind it: damp patches, salt efflorescence, plaster falling off, water pressing from the negative side. The outside cannot be reached.
WPS_T|/inner/solution: The classic system: plaster removed, joints raked out and levelled with {M30}, sealing fillet, a retroactive horizontal barrier with {I380} or {AQF}, then {AQ1K} in two application steps — three for pressing water (up to 0.75 bar from the negative side) — and the restoration plaster system THERMOPAL. {AQ1KP} when the next coat cannot wait; {RB400} for substrates prone to cracking and for radon.
WPS_T|/negc/name: Concrete basement wall, from the inside
WPS_T|/negc/problem: An existing in-situ concrete basement wall lets water through where the concrete is not dense: a construction joint with lime leaching and seepage, honeycombing at the base, formwork tie holes; the old paint flakes off. The outside cannot be dug up, so the waterproofing has to hold pressing water from the negative side (WTA 4-6, up to 0.75 bar).
WPS_T|/negc/solution: Substrate laid bare by high-pressure water jetting (> 400 bar), honeycombs broken out to sound concrete and filled with {M30}, the joint chased and filled, sealing cove of {M30}; pre-sealing with {AQ1K} against moisture from the rear; the construction joint with {RB400} 15 cm on both sides to ≥ 4.0 mm; then two coats of {RB400} to ≥ 3.0 mm dry film (WTA 4-6, water pressure) — flexible, crack-bridging and radon-tight; kept damp while it cures. {AQ1K} in three application steps is the rigid alternative for substrates not prone to cracking.
WPS_T|/tank/name: Tanks, basins and process water containers
WPS_T|/tank/problem: Concrete tanks hold water permanently (DIN 18535: W1-B fill level ≤ 5 m, W2-B ≤ 10 m): leaching, cracks, voids and honeycombs let water through; process, waste or soft water attacks the concrete.
WPS_T|/tank/solution: The system “Process water containers”: jet-cleaned, cracks sealed, voids re-profiled with {BIS540} on {HSF}, smoothed with {BIS16}; the wall–floor junction with {RB400} and ASO-Dichtband-2000-S; two coats of {RB400} (2.0 mm dry film for crack widths < 0.2 mm, 4.0 mm for < 1.0 mm); pressurised water after ≥ 1 day. Alternatives: {AQ2K} where chlorinated water is involved, {AQ1K} for process and waste water tanks.
WPS_T|/balcony/name: Balcony and terrace: bonded waterproofing under tiles
WPS_T|/balcony/problem: Rain, standing water and frost act on the balcony slab (DIN 18531) and on the wall–floor joint; the slab moves and cracks; tiles are laid directly on the waterproofing (DIN 18534, W0-I to W3-I).
WPS_T|/balcony/solution: {AQ2K} as bonded waterproofing: substrate levelled with {M30} and primed with ASO-Unigrund, ASO-Dichtband-2000 tapes and sleeves in the joints, two coats to > 2.0 mm dry film (3.5 kg/m² plus 25 % allowance), crack bridging even at −5 °C; the tiles follow with the tile adhesives of the system list when the waterproofing has hardened.
WPS_T|/park/name: Car park deck: OS 5b surface protection
WPS_T|/park/problem: De-icing salt, chlorides, carbonation and moving cracks attack the trafficked concrete of underground garages and multi-storey car parks; the reinforcement corrodes once the chlorides reach it.
WPS_T|/park/solution: {OS}, the approved OS 5b system after EN 1504-2: substrate milled to the neutral zone and prepared, a scratch coat and the first layer wet in wet, the second layer after approx. 3 hours, approx. 5.5 kg/m² in total. Chloride and CO₂ barrier, crack bridging class A4 static and B2 dynamic at −20 °C, UV resistant.
WPS_T|/layers/level/1: depressions > 5 mm, joints and uneven masonry levelled; edges chamfered, corners rounded
WPS_T|/layers/cove/1: on a bonding slurry of {AQ1K} or {M30}, wet in wet, rounded
WPS_T|/layers/sleeve/1: sleeve bonded in {RB400} with the 4 mm notched trowel, free from folds, fully overcoated
WPS_T|/layers/c1/1: brush, trowel or spray, free of pores; even thickness with the coating-thickness trowel
WPS_T|/layers/c1/2: approx. 1.1 mm wet per 1 mm dry
WPS_T|/layers/c1/5: A 1.5 : B 1, max. 0.24 l water / 24 kg
WPS_T|/layers/c2/1: when the first can no longer be damaged; to the dry film thickness of the class
WPS_T|/layers/c2/4: rainproof after approx. 3 h, 1 bar after approx. 16 h, boards after ≥ 1 day
WPS_T|/layers/board/1: bonded with {RB400} + quartz sand 0.1–0.35 mm (approx. 6 kg per 24 kg), buttering-floating
WPS_T|/layers/board/2: spot or full-area bonding by class
WPS_T|/layers/levelI/1: joints raked out approx. 20 mm and filled, depressions levelled, fillet at the wall–floor joint
WPS_T|/layers/levelI/3: approx. 1.4 kg/m² per mm; fillet approx. 3 kg/m
